semiconductor_relevance: High — Technic specializes in advanced chemistry solutions for semiconductor packaging and electroplating, which are critical for various semiconductor applications.
summary: Technic (China-HK) Limited provides a comprehensive range of advanced chemistries for semiconductor packaging, including electrodeposition solutions and high-performance photoresist strippers. Their products are designed to enhance yield and reliability in microelectronics manufacturing.
capabilities: Electrodeposition chemistries for RDL, pillars, microbumps, and LED packaging
High-performance photoresist strippers for liquid and dry film resists
Metal etchants and cleaners including TechniStrip®, TechniEtch, and Techniclean
Electroplating products for Cu, Ni, Sn, Au, Au/Sn, and In

regional_presence.China: Technic operates in Hong Kong, providing localized support for semiconductor applications.
